what_is.heading: What Are Diamonds in 99 Nights in the Forest?
paragraphs: Diamonds are the main currency in 99 Nights in the Forest. You spend them in the lobby on Classes, on buying or rolling Class talents, and on rerolling the Class Stock.

You can earn them for free: daily quests pay 5 each, chests and the Cultist Stronghold drop them, and you get a few for surviving past day 50 and day 99. You can also buy them for Robux in the Currency Shop.

official_prices.heading: Diamond Prices: Robux Shop vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: The Currency Shop sells Diamonds for Robux only, and Roblox Plus members get a discount. There's no direct cash price, so the real cost depends on how you buy your Robux.

extras.label: Roblox Plus
extras.detail: Lower Robux prices on Diamond packs, for example 20 Diamonds for 80 Robux

delivery.heading: How Diamond Delivery Works
steps: After checkout, send your Roblox username in the order chat.
Join 99 Nights in the Forest and stay in the lobby so the seller can find you.
The seller buys a Diamond pack with the gift button next to the Currency Shop and picks you as the receiver.
Check your Diamonds, then confirm the order.
delivery.typical_time: Sellers on DropMarket quote about 30 minutes while they're online.

support_topic.heading: Can You Gift Diamonds in 99 Nights in the Forest?
paragraphs: Yes, but only by paying Robux. The gift icon next to the Currency Shop lets a player buy a Diamond pack and choose who gets it.
You can't send Diamonds you already have. Gifts are new purchases, so the person sending pays the Robux.

faq_extra.q: How do you get free Diamonds in 99 Nights in the Forest?
faq_extra.a: Finish daily quests (5 each, 15 if you clear all three), open chests, beat the Cultist Stronghold, survive past day 50 and 99, and redeem codes from the Currency Shop's Codes button.

faq_extra.q: What do Diamonds buy in 99 Nights in the Forest?
faq_extra.a: Classes, Class talents and Class Stock rerolls in the lobby.
